skill_name: Tell me a story about a person who traveled worldwide.
workflow: Once upon a time, there was a man who wanted to see the world. He had no responsibilities and an adventurous spirit, so he set out on a journey to explore the world. He began by traveling to some of the most well known cities, such as London, Paris, Rome and New York. Then, he tried some of the more exotic destinations, like Macau, Bali and Cairo.
